## MoodBuro 0.3.0

- InspCal timetable reading for INSP’s Moodle: open supported weekly PDFs from the Moodle context menu or Downloads. Parsing runs locally on your Mac with the native InspCal engine and bundled PDFium.
- Save timetable weeks in Agenda for offline access, with week and list views, session details, rooms, speakers and links.
- Review group and attendance choices and inspect changes before saving a corrected week.
- Sync saved weeks to a dedicated “Emploi du temps” calendar in Apple Calendar, or export ICS snapshots.
- New InspCal settings for cohort, exported event prefix, reminders and Calendar sync, in French and English.

### Install or upgrade

From MoodBuro 0.2.0, check for updates in Settings → General. For a first installation or an earlier version, download the universal macOS DMG (Apple Silicon and Intel), verify it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`, quit MoodBuro, then drag the app into Applications.

The app is ad-hoc signed and not notarized. macOS may require first-launch approval in System Settings → Privacy & Security. macOS 12 is the configured minimum; full supported-platform, Intel runtime and installed update qualification remain in progress. Calendar sync requires Calendar access when prompted.

Timetable reading is available for INSP’s Moodle and supported timetable PDFs. Other Moodle organisations retain the existing courses and agenda features.

### Assets

- Universal `.dmg` installer
- Signed `.app.tar.gz` update archive and `.sig`
- `latest.json` stable update manifest for both Mac architectures
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`
